items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: HE WAS PLAYING IN THE TRUMPET SECTION. He played trumpet and alto. ... I kept him in the band.

ctx.x: NOW WHERE DID YOU GET HIM, WHEN DID YOU GET HIM? WAS HE THERE WHEN YOU WERE STILL IN TEXAS? I THOUGHT YOU DIDN'T GET HIM UNTIL YOU CAME BACK DOWN TO TEXAS AGAIN.
That's what I don't exactly remember.
